meta: A plain ad report on spend, results and next steps, built from your own accounts. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Monthly ad reports in plain language
overview: We turn your ad account numbers into a report you can read in five minutes. We pull spend, clicks, leads or sales and cost per result from your own accounts, compare them with the previous period, and explain what changed and why. Each report ends with three clear next steps. You can receive it as a document or a live dashboard link, depending on the package.

faq: No. This is a single report for one month of data. If you want one every month, ask for a written quote for monthly care and we agree a regular price.
Spend, impressions, clicks, leads or sales, cost per result and return on spend, shown the way your accounts record them. We note anything we cannot verify, such as sales that happen offline.
Can you report from the platforms I already use?
Yes for Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest and Microsoft ads, plus Google Analytics. For anything else, tell us in the order form, and we confirm it before we begin.
Do you need to manage my ads to report on them?
No. We only need view access to your accounts. If the report shows something that needs fixing, we can quote the changes separately, but you are not required to hire us for them.
